title: PSC General Knowledge
description: Kerala, the Indian Constitution and history: questions that come up often in Kerala PSC.

cards.question: When was the state of Kerala formed?
cards.answer: 1 November 1956, under the States Reorganisation Act.

cards.question: How many districts does Kerala have?
Who was the first Chief Minister of Kerala?
cards.answer: E. M. S. Namboodiripad, in 1957.

cards.question: Which is the longest river in Kerala?
cards.answer: Periyar, about 244 km long.
cards.note: CHECK: 244 km is the usual PSC figure, but some sources give a different length. Confirm against the PSC guide you use.

cards.question: Which is the highest peak in Kerala, and where is it?
cards.answer: Anamudi (2,695 m), in Eravikulam National Park, Idukki. It is also the highest peak in South India.

cards.question: Which is the largest lake in Kerala?
cards.answer: Vembanad Lake.

cards.question: Where and when did Vasco da Gama land in Kerala?
cards.answer: At Kappad, near Kozhikode (Calicut), in 1498.

cards.question: What are Kerala's state animal and state bird?
cards.answer: State animal: Indian elephant. State bird: great hornbill.

cards.question: What is Kerala's state fish?
cards.answer: Karimeen (pearl spot).

cards.question: In which district is Silent Valley National Park?
cards.answer: Palakkad.

cards.question: Where is the Kerala High Court, and which Union Territory also comes under it?
cards.answer: Kochi (Ernakulam). It also covers Lakshadweep.

cards.question: What was the Vaikom Satyagraha?
cards.answer: A 1924–25 movement for the right of all castes to use the roads around the Vaikom temple.

cards.question: When was the Temple Entry Proclamation made, and by whom?
cards.answer: In 1936, by Sree Chithira Thirunal Balarama Varma, Maharaja of Travancore.

cards.question: Who is known as the father of the Malayalam language?
cards.answer: Thunchath Ramanujan Ezhuthachan.

cards.question: What is Sree Narayana Guru's famous message?
cards.answer: "One caste, one religion, one God for man." He also inspired the founding of the SNDP Yogam in 1903.
cards.note: CHECK: confirm the exact English wording of the quote and the SNDP Yogam detail (he was its first president).

cards.question: When was the Indian Constitution adopted, and when did it come into force?
cards.answer: Adopted on 26 November 1949. Came into force on 26 January 1950.

cards.question: Who chaired the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
cards.answer: Dr B. R. Ambedkar.

cards.question: What does Article 21 of the Constitution protect?
cards.answer: The right to life and personal liberty.

cards.question: Which article gives the right to education, and for which ages?
cards.answer: Article 21A, added by the 86th Amendment (2002): free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14.

cards.question: How were the Fundamental Duties added, and how many are there now?
cards.answer: Added by the 42nd Amendment (1976) in Article 51A. There are 11 now; the 11th was added by the 86th Amendment (2002).

cards.question: Which is the largest Indian state by area?
cards.answer: Rajasthan.

cards.question: Who wrote India's national song, Vande Mataram?
cards.answer: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay, in his novel Anandamath.

cards.question: In which year did the First War of Indian Independence begin?
What was the Dandi March?
cards.answer: Gandhi's Salt Satyagraha in 1930: a march from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi (12 March to 6 April) to break the salt law.

cards.question: Deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
cards.answer: Vitamin C.
